open AspisR1TerminalDecoder
abbrev Value := pool_v1.pair_terminal.PoolV1PairVerifiedAfterstateV1
abbrev ChildError := pool_v1.pair_terminal.PoolV1PairVerifierTransportErrorV1
abbrev Error := pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.PoolV1PairLatePublicStatementErrorV1

def PacketDomain (bytes : Slice U8) : Prop := bytes.val.length=688

def reference (reply : core.result.Result Value ChildError) :
 Result (core.result.Result Value Error) := do
 let raw ← NEC_Reference.boxed_ref reply
 match raw with
 | .Ok value => ok (.Ok value)
 | .Err (.Child error) => ok (.Err (.Afterstate error))

/-- Exact emitted wrapper over the SAME child Result, including all child errors.
The child decoder's own native bridge is separate and must be instantiated. -/
theorem emitted (bytes : Slice U8) (reply : core.result.Result Value ChildError)
 (child : pool_v1.pair_terminal.decode_pool_v1_pair_verified_afterstate_v1 bytes=ok reply) :
 pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.decode_pair_afterstate_boxed_v1 bytes=reference reply := by
 unfold pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.decode_pair_afterstate_boxed_v1
 rw [child]
 cases reply <;> rfl

/-- The native selected-word observation is valid for every projection, so
finite record assembly does not strengthen the input domain. -/
theorem value_project (reply : core.result.Result Value ChildError) (value : Value)
 (returned : reference reply=ok (.Ok value)) : reply=.Ok value := by
 cases reply <;> simp_all [reference,NEC_Reference.boxed_ref]

#print axioms emitted
#print axioms value_project
end NEC_AfterstateBox

def run (bytes : Slice U8) := do
  let reply ← NBN_AfterstateDecoderDependency.run (fun b => ok (NBP_DigestDecode.decoded b)) bytes
  NEC_AfterstateBox.reference reply

trace. Native Box allocation and cleanup are checked separately under (aa). -/

    (run bytes,state,([] : List Unit)) =

  exact congrArg (fun r => (r,state,([] : List Unit))) (NED_AfterBoxComposition.result bytes).symm

from its own domain, with no inner-domain premise. -/

    bytes.to_slice.val.length = 688 := bytes.property

/-- Native projections quantify every scalar/limb/frontier entry. -/

    (index : a.next_pair_index=b.next_pair_index)
    (root : ∀ i : Fin 8, NEU_PublicProjections.get a.next_root i = NEU_PublicProjections.get b.next_root i)
    (frontier : ∀ k : Fin 20, ∀ i : Fin 8,
      NEU_PublicProjections.get (NEU_PublicProjections.get a.next_frontier k) i =
      NEU_PublicProjections.get (NEU_PublicProjections.get b.next_frontier k) i) : a=b := by
  have hr := NED_WindowExtensionality.array_ext a.next_root b.next_root root
  have hf : a.next_frontier=b.next_frontier := by
    apply NED_WindowExtensionality.array_ext
    intro k
    exact NED_WindowExtensionality.array_ext _ _ (frontier k)
  cases a
  cases b
  simp_all only

#print axioms value_ext

/-- Reuse the already audited complete common projection family by embedding
both late values at the same untouched outer record. -/
theorem late (base : Common) (a b : Late)
    (point : ∀ slot i j k,
      NEU_CommonProjections.value (NED_ReconstructCarriers.toRawCommon {base with lane_transition:=a}) slot i j k =

    (point : ∀ slot i j k,
      NEU_CommonProjections.value (NED_ReconstructCarriers.toRawCommon
        {base with lane_transition:={base.lane_transition with live_snapshot:=a}}) slot i j k =
      NEU_CommonProjections.value (NED_ReconstructCarriers.toRawCommon
        {base with lane_transition:={base.lane_transition with live_snapshot:=b}}) slot i j k) : a=b := by
  have same := NEU_DecoderProjections.common_ext
    {base with lane_transition:={base.lane_transition with live_snapshot:=a}}
    {base with lane_transition:={base.lane_transition with live_snapshot:=b}} point
  exact congrArg (fun c : Common => c.lane_transition.live_snapshot) same

separate; list geometry alone earns no native credit. -/

    ((bytes.val.drop 112).take 32).length=32 ∧

import AspisR1TerminalDecoder.Funs
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NEX_FirstError
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std
variable {A E : Type}
/-- A native decoder stops at the first error. Replies after it are not an
admission restriction, since the caller never asks for them. -/
def first : List (core.result.Result A E) → Nat
 | [] => 0
 | .Err _ :: _ => 0
 | .Ok _ :: xs => 1+first xs

theorem bounded (xs : List (core.result.Result A E)) : first xs≤xs.length := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih => cases x <;> simp only [first,List.length_cons] <;> omega

theorem before (xs : List (core.result.Result A E)) (i : Nat) (hi : i<first xs) :
    ∃ a, xs[i]?=some (.Ok a) := by
  induction xs generalizing i with
  | nil => simp only [first] at hi; omega
  | cons x xs ih =>
    cases x with
    | Err e => simp only [first] at hi; omega
    | Ok a =>
      cases i with
      | zero => exact ⟨a,rfl⟩
      | succ i =>
        have bound : i<first xs := by simp only [first] at hi; omega
        exact ih i bound

theorem at_error (xs : List (core.result.Result A E)) (hi : first xs<xs.length) :
    ∃ e, xs[first xs]?=some (.Err e) := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => simp only [first,List.length_nil] at hi; omega
  | cons x xs ih =>
    cases x with
    | Err e => exact ⟨e,rfl⟩
    | Ok a =>
      have bound : first xs<xs.length := by simp only [first,List.length_cons] at hi; omega
      simpa only [first, Nat.add_comm 1, List.getElem?_cons_succ] using ih bound

#print axioms bounded
#print axioms before
#print axioms at_error
end NEX_FirstError

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NEX_StatementExt
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std
open AspisR1TerminalDecoder.pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal
abbrev Statement := PoolV1PairForestTerminalStatementV1

def project (s : Statement) (slot : Fin 26) (i : Fin 8) (j : Fin 32) (k : Fin 20) : Nat :=
 match s with
 | .PrivateTransfer c p =>
   if slot.val=0 then 1 else
   if h : slot.val<16 then
     NEU_CommonProjections.value (NED_ReconstructCarriers.toRawCommon c) ⟨slot.val-1,by omega⟩ i j k
   else if h : slot.val<24 then
     NEU_PublicProjections.transfer (NED_PaymentCohorts.toRawTransfer p) ⟨slot.val-16,by omega⟩ i j
   else 0
 | .Withdrawal c p =>
   if slot.val=0 then 2 else
   if h : slot.val<16 then
     NEU_CommonProjections.value (NED_ReconstructCarriers.toRawCommon c) ⟨slot.val-1,by omega⟩ i j k
   else if h : slot.val<23 then
     NEU_PublicProjections.withdrawal (NED_PaymentCohorts.toRawWithdrawal p) ⟨slot.val-16,by omega⟩ i j
   else if slot.val=24 then
     NEU_PublicProjections.withdrawal (NED_PaymentCohorts.toRawWithdrawal p) ⟨7,by decide⟩ i j
   else if slot.val=25 then
     NEU_PublicProjections.withdrawal (NED_PaymentCohorts.toRawWithdrawal p) ⟨8,by decide⟩ i j
   else 0

theorem complete (a b : Statement)
 (point : ∀ slot i j k, project a slot i j k=project b slot i j k) : a=b := by
 cases a with
 | PrivateTransfer c p =>
  cases b with
  | PrivateTransfer d q =>
   apply NEU_DecoderProjections.transfer_ext
   · intro slot i j k
     have h := point ⟨slot.val+1,by omega⟩ i j k
     simpa [project,show slot.val+1≠0 by omega,show slot.val+1<16 by omega] using h
   · intro slot i j
     have h := point ⟨slot.val+16,by omega⟩ i j ⟨0,by decide⟩
     simpa [project,show slot.val+16≠0 by omega,show ¬slot.val+16<16 by omega,show slot.val+16<24 by omega] using h
  | Withdrawal d q =>
   have bad := point ⟨0,by decide⟩ ⟨0,by decide⟩ ⟨0,by decide⟩ ⟨0,by decide⟩
   simp [project] at bad
 | Withdrawal c p =>
  cases b with
  | PrivateTransfer d q =>
   have bad := point ⟨0,by decide⟩ ⟨0,by decide⟩ ⟨0,by decide⟩ ⟨0,by decide⟩
   simp [project] at bad
  | Withdrawal d q =>
   apply NEU_DecoderProjections.withdrawal_ext
   · intro slot i j k
     have h := point ⟨slot.val+1,by omega⟩ i j k
     simpa [project,show slot.val+1≠0 by omega,show slot.val+1<16 by omega] using h
   · intro slot i j
     by_cases small : slot.val<7
     · have h := point ⟨slot.val+16,by omega⟩ i j ⟨0,by decide⟩
       simpa [project,show slot.val+16≠0 by omega,show ¬slot.val+16<16 by omega,show slot.val+16<23 by omega] using h
     · by_cases seven : slot.val=7
       · have same : slot=⟨7,by decide⟩ := Fin.ext seven
         subst slot
         exact point ⟨24,by decide⟩ i j ⟨0,by decide⟩
       · have eight : slot=⟨8,by decide⟩ := Fin.ext (by change slot.val=8; omega)
         subst slot
         exact point ⟨25,by decide⟩ i j ⟨0,by decide⟩

#print axioms complete
end NEX_StatementExt

import NEY_BindingSuccess

namespace NEY_ReachedResultDomains
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1TerminalDecoder
open pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal
open AspisR1.S2K
abbrev Statement := StatementAdmission.Statement
abbrev Record := PoolV1PairForestTerminalResultV1

def DerivedRecord (record : Record) : Prop := ∃ s : Statement, record=ResultAdmission.value s

def ReadyRecord (record : Record) : Prop :=
  ∃ s : Statement, record=ResultAdmission.value s ∧
    validate_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_statement_v1 s=ok (.Ok ())

theorem binding_argument (s : Statement) : DerivedRecord (ResultAdmission.value s) := ⟨s,rfl⟩

/-- This is the actual reached branch condition at emit_result's encoder call. -/
theorem encoder_argument (s : Statement)
    (bound : validate_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_result_against_statement_v1 s
      (ResultAdmission.value s)=ok (.Ok ())) : ReadyRecord (ResultAdmission.value s) :=
  ⟨s,rfl,NEY_BindingSuccess.binding_success s bound⟩

theorem ready_payload (record : Record) (ready : ReadyRecord record) :
    ∃ s : Statement, record=ResultAdmission.value s ∧
      encode_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_result_v1 record=
        ok (.Ok (ResultPayload.bytes s)) := by
  obtain ⟨s,same,valid⟩ := ready
  refine ⟨s,same,?_⟩
  rw [same]
  exact ResultPayload.encoded s valid

#print axioms binding_argument
#print axioms encoder_argument
#print axioms ready_payload
end NEY_ReachedResultDomains

import NEL_CopyArrayLaw
import JHb_S2K_ResultEncoding
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NEY_ResultStores
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result

def observe {α : Type} (xs : List α) : Nat → Option α := fun k => xs[k]?

theorem copy_observe {α : Type} (dst src : List α) (start : Nat)
    (fits : start+src.length≤dst.length) :
    observe (dst.setSlice! start src) =
      KMX_CopyMeaning.loop (fun j => src[j-start]?) (observe dst) start src.length := by
  funext k
  rw [KMX_CopyMeaning.loop_spec]
  by_cases inside : start≤k ∧ k<start+src.length
  · rw [if_pos inside]
    exact NEL_CopyArrayLaw.list_inside dst src start k fits inside
  · rw [if_neg inside]
    exact NEJ_ArrayFrame.list_frame dst src start k fits (by omega)

theorem set_observe {α : Type} (dst : List α) (i : Nat) (value : α)
    (inside : i<dst.length) :
    observe (dst.set i value) = KMX_CopyMeaning.write (observe dst) i (some value) := by
  funext k
  unfold observe KMX_CopyMeaning.write
  by_cases same : k=i
  · subst k
    rw [if_pos rfl,List.getElem?_set_self inside]
  · rw [if_neg same]
    exact List.getElem?_set_ne (Ne.symm same)

def writes (out : Array U8 792#usize) (master selected nullifier : Array U8 32#usize)
    (kind lane : U8) (afterstate : Array U8 688#usize) : Nat → Option U8 :=
  let magic := KMX_CopyMeaning.loop
    (fun j => ([65#u8,83#u8,82#u8,56#u8] : List U8)[j]?) (observe out.val) 0 4
  let version := KMX_CopyMeaning.write magic 4 (some 1#u8)
  let transition := KMX_CopyMeaning.write version 5 (some kind)
  let digestVersion := KMX_CopyMeaning.write transition 6 (some 1#u8)
  let outputLane := KMX_CopyMeaning.write digestVersion 7 (some lane)
  let masterBytes := KMX_CopyMeaning.loop (fun j => master.val[j-8]?) outputLane 8 32
  let selectedBytes := KMX_CopyMeaning.loop (fun j => selected.val[j-40]?) masterBytes 40 32
  let nullifierBytes := KMX_CopyMeaning.loop (fun j => nullifier.val[j-72]?) selectedBytes 72 32
  KMX_CopyMeaning.loop (fun j => afterstate.val[j-104]?) nullifierBytes 104 688

/-- The actual emitted model stores have exactly the nine KMX window laws,
including every byte outside the selected window's footprint. -/
theorem stores_observe (out : Array U8 792#usize) (master selected nullifier : Array U8 32#usize)
    (kind lane : U8) (afterstate : Array U8 688#usize) :
    observe (AspisR1.S2K.ResultEncoding.stores out master selected nullifier kind lane afterstate).val =
      writes out master selected nullifier kind lane afterstate := by
  unfold AspisR1.S2K.ResultEncoding.stores
  simp [writes,copy_observe,set_observe,List.length_setSlice!,List.length_set,
    out.property,master.property,selected.property,nullifier.property,afterstate.property]

#print axioms copy_observe
#print axioms set_observe
#print axioms stores_observe
end NEY_ResultStores

import NEY_ResultStores
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NEY_ResultProjection
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std

def expected (out : Array U8 792#usize) (master selected nullifier : Array U8 32#usize)
    (kind lane : U8) (afterstate : Array U8 688#usize) (k : Nat) : Option U8 :=
  if 104≤k ∧ k<792 then afterstate.val[k-104]?
  else if 72≤k ∧ k<104 then nullifier.val[k-72]?
  else if 40≤k ∧ k<72 then selected.val[k-40]?
  else if 8≤k ∧ k<40 then master.val[k-8]?
  else if k=7 then some lane
  else if k=6 then some 1#u8
  else if k=5 then some kind
  else if k=4 then some 1#u8
  else if k<4 then ([65#u8,83#u8,82#u8,56#u8] : List U8)[k]?
  else out.val[k]?

theorem writes_spec (out : Array U8 792#usize) (master selected nullifier : Array U8 32#usize)
    (kind lane : U8) (afterstate : Array U8 688#usize) (k : Nat) :
    NEY_ResultStores.writes out master selected nullifier kind lane afterstate k =
      expected out master selected nullifier kind lane afterstate k := by
  simp only [NEY_ResultStores.writes,expected,KMX_CopyMeaning.loop_spec,KMX_CopyMeaning.write,
    Nat.zero_le,true_and,Nat.sub_zero]
  rfl

theorem stores_spec (out : Array U8 792#usize) (master selected nullifier : Array U8 32#usize)
    (kind lane : U8) (afterstate : Array U8 688#usize) (k : Nat) :
    (AspisR1.S2K.ResultEncoding.stores out master selected nullifier kind lane afterstate).val[k]? =
      expected out master selected nullifier kind lane afterstate k := by
  change NEY_ResultStores.observe _ k = _
  rw [NEY_ResultStores.stores_observe,writes_spec]

#print axioms writes_spec
#print axioms stores_spec
end NEY_ResultProjection

theorem payment_offset : PAYMENT_STATEMENT_OFFSET=ok 1664#usize := by
  obtain ⟨n,run,value⟩ := spec_imp_exists AspisS6NativeForestDecodeHelpers.payment_offset_spec
  have same : n=1664#usize := by scalar_tac
  simpa only [same] using run

#print AspisR1TerminalDecoder.pool_v1.format.POOL_V1_DIGEST_ENCODING_VERSION

theorem header_constants :
    POOL_V1_PAIR_FOREST_TERMINAL_STATEMENT_MAGIC.val=[65#u8,83#u8,70#u8,56#u8] ∧
    POOL_V1_PAIR_FOREST_TERMINAL_VERSION=1#u8 ∧
    pool_v1.format.POOL_V1_DIGEST_ENCODING_VERSION=1#u8 := by
  constructor
  · unfold POOL_V1_PAIR_FOREST_TERMINAL_STATEMENT_MAGIC
    rfl
  constructor
  · unfold POOL_V1_PAIR_FOREST_TERMINAL_VERSION
    rfl
  · unfold AspisR1TerminalDecoder.pool_v1.format.POOL_V1_DIGEST_ENCODING_VERSION
    rfl

/-- The actual extracted successful kind call chooses the SAME payment branch. -/
theorem kind_same (byte : U8) (kind : pool_v1.historical_anchor.PoolV1TransitionKind)
    (accepted : transition_kind byte=ok (.Ok kind)) :
    (read_discriminant kind : U8)=byte := by
  obtain ⟨r,run,value⟩ := spec_imp_exists (AspisS6NativeForestDecodeHelpers.kind_spec byte)
  have same : r=.Ok kind := Result.ok.inj (run.symm.trans accepted)
  exact value kind same

/-- The real model offset, not an independent literal window, supplies216 bytes. -/
theorem payment_window (bytes : Array U8 1880#usize) :
    (do let offset ← PAYMENT_STATEMENT_OFFSET
        ok (bytes.val.drop offset.val).length) = ok 216 := by
  rw [payment_offset]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok,List.length_drop,bytes.property]
  rfl

#print axioms payment_offset
#print axioms header_constants
#print axioms kind_same
#print axioms payment_window
end NEY_TerminalGeometry
